title: First special sitting of 2024

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2024/ޚޞ/1).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for appointment as Prosecutor General, under Article 3(b) of the Prosecutor General's Act (Law No. 9/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the bill amending Law No. 7/2023 (Companies Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo North MP Ismail Nizar.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first special sitting, held at 9 pm, was scheduled to send the new Prosecutor General nominee to committee and introduce a bill amending the Companies Act.
